+Scope: 54d7f24..HEAD (5 commits: 1c7e549 chunk-semantics suite rewrite = task ^t71kdmj; ed42775+0d26e8b byte-budget LRU eviction + slot-limit API removal = task ^2sdt6dj; b20ecd9/0cce82d test fixture dedup + docs).
+
+Empirically verified alongside the engine pass: 181 tests / 34 suites all green; public setPromptCacheByteBudget landed with the peak-memory model documented ("peak ≈ byteBudget + in-flight requests × assembled-prefix size"); orphan-lineage reclamation implemented in PromptCache.swift and tested in PromptCacheByteBudgetTests.swift.
+
+## Review Findings (2026-07-11 06:52)
+
+- [ ] `Libraries/MLXFoundationModels/MLXLanguageModel.swift:186` — Empty collection initialized with array literal instead of Set constructor. Set has no literal syntax in Swift, so `Set<String> = []` is not idiomatic — use `Set<String>()` instead. The rule 'Empty-collection variables use a literal with a type annotation, not a call' applies to Array and Dictionary which have literals (`[]` and `[:]`), but Set must use the constructor form when empty. Change `private var suppressedLoadIDs: Set<String> = []` to `private var suppressedLoadIDs: Set<String> = Set()` or use the shorthand `private var suppressedLoadIDs = Set<String>()`.
+- [ ] `Libraries/MLXFoundationModels/MLXLanguageModel.swift:318` — The cache-get-or-create pattern in `makeXgTokenizer` (lines 318-335) and `makeTokenizerBias` (lines 357-375) are near-verbatim duplicates that differ only in the cache dictionary name and creation logic. Both follow: check cache with modelID key → if found return → create new item → store in cache → return item. This should be extracted to a single generic helper to avoid drift. Extract a generic `getOrCreateCached` helper method that takes the cache dictionary, modelID, and a creation closure. Call it from both `makeXgTokenizer` and `makeTokenizerBias` to eliminate the duplication and ensure they stay in sync.
\ No newline at end of file
